title: The Path of Daggers
author: Robert Jordan
summary: The eighth Wheel of Time book. The series follows a young man marked to face the Dark One, and in this installment armies move and alliances are tested as several leaders pursue their own plans across the continent.
readIf: you are far into the Wheel of Time and enjoy its many plots, politics and slow-turning world.
skipIf: you have not read the series so far, or you dislike slow middle volumes.

pairings.reason: Another multi-viewpoint epic where several factions struggle for control of the same realm.
A single, self-contained epic with a similar breadth of politics, dragons and prophecy.
A much denser, less forgiving epic fantasy for readers who like to be thrown into a big world.
